headline: ExxonMobil adds Williams as its seventh CO2 storage customer for the Louisiana Energy Gateway
summary: Williams selected ExxonMobil to transport and permanently store up to 1 million tonnes per year of CO2 from its proposed Louisiana Energy Gateway gas gathering and processing system; it is ExxonMobil's seventh commercial CCS customer and fifth in Louisiana, lifting its contracted CO2 transport-and-storage portfolio to about 9 Mtpa. The project remains subject to FID, permitting and other approvals.
co2crc_note: Reinforces the commercial CO2 transport-and-storage-as-a-service hub model that Australian storage hubs (CarbonNet, Bayu-Undan) aim to replicate.
